:::note[Generated]
The `state_list` tool as the server lists it in `tools/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.4.0 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.

List the resources in the workspace's state — `tofu state list`, one row per instance in address order with its provider, schema version, taint, dependencies and identity — plus the root outputs. include_values adds each resource's attributes, read from the engine's records with the sensitive_values the provider schemas mark; sensitive values print as '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' unless show_sensitive.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | true |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
| `include_values` | boolean | no | Include each resource's attribute values (default false), read from the engine's records with their sensitive_values. |
| `show_sensitive` | boolean | no | Print sensitive values in the clear instead of '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' (default false). Only when you need the secret: it enters the conversation. |
